description:
Boost any post Siren made: it becomes a Meta ad with its own
picture or video and caption, sent PAUSED. No credits; nothing spends
until go_live_ad_campaign and the human's yes. Pass the run_id, or a
post_id from list_posts (each row says boosted_campaign_id once it
is). With neither it lists the posts that did best lately so you can
pick one with the human. A post boosted before answers with that
campaign.

daily_budget_cents.description: Budget a day in minor units (2000 is $20), inside the caps.

days.description: How long the ad runs once on, 1 to 90; 7 if omitted.

post_id.description: Or a post id from list_posts; its run is boosted.

run_id.description: The post's run_id. Omit both ids to list the posts worth boosting.

name: boost_post
